title: Replenish the screening pool above the 70-unit floor
body:
After t-zk8cmrz (#1312) exactly 70 units are verified, the MIN_VERIFIED floor: any further drop makes verify exit 1.
Outcome: at least 80 verified units, screened after t-qjf9g6c makes the install phase safe.
Proof: node evals/units/screening.ts verify --recorded prints units: N verified with N >= 80, exit 0.
Files: evals/units/screening-manifest.json, evals/units/
